lines.text: 6 gears are meshed in a row, and their teeth do not slip. The first gear turns clockwise.
Which way does the last gear turn?
Lock in your answer. Now watch what actually happens.
The last gear turns counter-clockwise, the opposite way from the first.
Two meshed gears always turn opposite ways, so every mesh flips the direction. With 6 gears there are 5 meshes. 5 flips leave one flip over, so the last gear is reversed.
An odd number of gears gives the same direction. Follow for a new puzzle every day.

lines.text: A delivery drone travels 120 kilometers at 24 kilometers per hour, then comes back the same way at 40.
What is its average speed for the whole trip? Careful, the obvious answer is wrong.
The tempting answer is halfway between the two speeds, 32. But the delivery drone spends more time at the slower speed, so that leg counts for more.
Going out takes 120 divided by 24, which is 5 hours.
Coming back takes 120 divided by 40, which is 3 hours.
That is 240 kilometers in 8 hours.
So the average speed is 30 kilometers per hour, not 32.
Average speed is total distance over total time. Follow for a new puzzle every day.
